task.question: Construct and certify finite orbit-to-cell assignments with exact retained mass and charged deletion/transport.
task.domain: Rational finite graphs and synthetic exponential lists, not actual zeta zeros.
assumptions: Whole conjugation orbits; mandatory clipping leaves marks1/2.
Target Q,inset,radius,cap and nonnegative scalar objective weights are fixed.
Analytic source-to-model consequence is conditional on pinned parent proofs.

backend_decision.selection_reason: Portable exact rational graph solver and independently callable certificate checker; no CAS-specific operation is required.
backend_decision.readiness: Executable and library imports live-checked; sage and wolframscript not on PATH.
backend_decision.inventory_boundary: Bundled backend-inventory and record validators were not executed. No general MCP availability claim.

development_runs.scope: Development check before adding the repeated-cluster regression.

precision.exact: All graph costs, flows, dual potentials,cuts,clipping and cosh enclosures use integers/Fraction.
precision.numeric: Binary64 complex kernels and two-panel96-node Gauss-Legendre;100-digit mpmath comparison of rational cosh enclosures.
precision.tolerance: 2e-9*(1+abs(left)+abs(right)) in numerical checks; no float tolerance in certificate checks.

result_summary.scope: Small synthetic transfer upper bounds are conservative; no actual zero matching or small-cost asymptotic is certified.

limitations: No actual zeta-zero data or asymptotically small matching cost is established.
No independent mathematical verification, unconditional zero-proportion improvement or RH proof.
The optimum concerns a conservative linear surrogate, not the true quadratic charge or signed operator norm.
Exhaustive graph families and brute-force assignments are explicitly finite; analytic all-size claims remain proof candidates.
No full-repository local tests,upstream Lean build or actual zero computation.
